gpu: 1 node x 8 x A100 80GB, TP=1 per lane
native_protocol: vLLM native speculative decoding; greedy verification; fresh engine per stage; target always verifies with full vision

blocked_drafters.domino: Domino 8B bootstrap requires DOMINO_FULL_PREFLIGHT.json and a signed runtime-approval receipt; neither is bundled

notes: vLLM 0.22.1 is used with the pinned rejection sampler; the only source patch is the drafter visual-KV hook.
The visual-KV hook is methods/research/visual_context_horizon/matrix/visual_kv_hook.py; its SHA256 is recorded in artifacts/manifests/runtime_manifest.json.
Exp1-Exp3 never call torch.cuda.synchronize; Exp4 profiling runs in a separate stage process.
Engine startup, compilation and the three warmup requests per cell are excluded from timed requests.
